purpose: Independent methodological cross-checks; not external certification of every preprint theorem or empirical result. These sources are not hidden prerequisites for candidates.

sources.title: Bayes in the sky: Bayesian inference and model selection in cosmology
sources.verification: Evidence averages likelihood under a specified prior. Prior support and normalization matter; information criteria and evidence need not rank models identically. Comparisons require matched assumptions/data, not merely the same baseline name.

sources.title: Clay Mathematics Institute — Riemann Hypothesis
sources.verification: Independent context for the distinction between a conditional statement about zeta zeros and an accepted proof of RH. The scoring key uses the supplied statements and their conditions, not an unverified claim of resolution.

sources.title: Existence and Smoothness of the Navier–Stokes Equation, Charles L. Fefferman
sources.verification: A priori estimates on regular solutions or conditional continuation criteria do not by themselves settle existence/smoothness for every datum in the full problem. No status prediction about pending submissions is used as a scored fact.
